integrity: The proof rewrites each crown neighborhood as the opposite bipartition side with one matched vertex removed, yielding an exact per-side capacity criterion. Enumeration then factorizes over the two sides and uses inclusion-exclusion for surjectivity.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to crown graphs K_{n,n} minus a perfect matching for n at least three.
The n=3 scalar value is already covered by the published cycle result; the accepted contribution is the uniform crown structure, spectrum, and enumeration.
The finite verifier is corroborative; arbitrary n is proved analytically.
Coloring counts use labeled colors and do not quotient by automorphisms.
title: Strong majority vertex-colorings of crown graphs
